newsitem.title: FINLAND: S.SANOMAT SAYS K-SUOMEN MEDIA MUST REDEEM.
newsitem.headline: S.SANOMAT SAYS K-SUOMEN MEDIA MUST REDEEM.

text.p: Finnish publishing company Savon Sanomat Oy said on Monday that Keski-Suomen Media Oy's ownership in it had risen over two thirds, to 73.3 percent of shares and votes after deals last Friday and on Monday.
Since the holding now exceeded two thirds, Keski-Suomen Media would be obliged to make a redemption offer for all outstanding shares in Savon Sanomat, it said in a statement.

At 1510/1310 GMT, Savon Sanomat traded at an unchanged 67.00 markka. Last Friday, Merita transacted in-house a block of 176,777 shares, and on Monday, Opstock moved in-house a block of 29,648 shares. Both deals were at 67.00 markka per share.
